title: CBI Files Supplementary Chargesheet in NEET Paper Leak Case
detail: The Central Bureau of Investigation filed a supplementary chargesheet in the NEET-UG paper leak case, advancing legal proceedings against those accused in the national medical entrance exam fraud. The NEET paper leak was a key trigger for the India Youth Uprising, which began in mid-2024 when students across the country protested against widespread examination irregularities that undermined fair access to medical education.
